title: Sign Means Sign
hook: A sign that only lets some cars up.
scene: The chain-up area is a wide pull-out nobody has plowed in two years. The sign at the mouth of it is the one that is not asking: chains required. You have a set in the trunk, still cold from the last time you were told to go earn it. Across the road the Quiet stand in the drifts up to their knees, facing uphill, and Deac watches the grass instead of the sign because he already knows what the sign says.
decision: Chains required. You have a set in the trunk. What now?

options.text: Chains on the drive wheels — the rear pair — before the car moves.
options.result: Drape, hook, tighten, and keep the tensioner off the ice. The Menace's drive wheels are the rear pair, so that is where the chains go — on before the car moves. Ten minutes, and the sign is satisfied: the car is carrying the equipment it names.

options.text: Go up slow and careful on the all-seasons.
options.result: Slow is not a substitute for the equipment the sign names. On snow the tires you have are the tires you have, and a careful crawl in the wrong shoes is a skid waiting for a corner. Go back down and put the chains on.

options.text: Ask Deac to drive it up for you.
options.result: He won't. The sign is about the car, and the car is yours now. Handing over the wheel on a chain-required road teaches nobody anything except how to wait.

options.text: Leave the car and walk the pass.
options.result: The pass is miles of wind and the Quiet are already standing in it. The car is the only thing up here that can carry you and two cats out of the weather.

debrief: The sign says chains required, so the chains go on the drive wheels before the car moves. On the Menace that is the rear pair. Snow also asks for more space and a lot less speed; a careful crawl on the wrong tires is still a skid.

source.teaching_target: 5.6: 'Use snow tires or chains when it's required.' 4.12 lists the chain advisory sign. The guide names no axle; a chain goes on the wheels that drive the car, and the Menace's drive pair is the rear.
